mapper.sql: id, code, name, name_local, model_code, description, source, external_ref_id, external_version, last_sync_time, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid

v.id, v.code, v.name, v.name_local, v.model_code, v.description, v.source, v.external_ref_id, v.external_version, v.last_sync_time, v.create_time, v.create_by, v.modify_time, v.modify_by, v.row_version, v.row_valid, m.car_line_code, m.platform_code
FROM tb_mdm_variant v LEFT JOIN tb_mdm_model m ON m.code = v.model_code AND m.row_valid = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_mdm_variant ( id, code, name, name_local, model_code, description, source, external_ref_id, external_version, last_sync_time, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{nameLocal}, #{modelCode}, #{description}, #{source}, #{externalRefId}, #{externalVersion}, #{lastSyncTime}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{modifyBy}, 1, 1 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_mdm_variant t SET
t.code = #{code},
t.name = #{name},
t.name_local = #{nameLocal},
t.model_code = #{modelCode},
t.description = #{description},
t.source = #{source},
t.external_ref_id = #{externalRefId},
t.external_version = #{externalVersion},
t.last_sync_time = #{lastSyncTime},
t.modify_by = #{modifyBy},
t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_mdm_variant t SET t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now(), t.row_valid = 0 WHERE t.id = #{value}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_mdm_variant t WHERE t.id = #{value}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_mdm_variant t WHERE t.id = #{value} AND t.row_valid = 1

SELECT FROM tb_mdm_variant t WHERE t.row_valid = 1
AND t.model_code = #{modelCode}
AND t.code = #{code}
AND (t.name LIKE #{name} OR t.name_local LIKE #{name})
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT FROM tb_mdm_variant t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.code = #{code} LIMIT 1
